summary: A Yes vote establishes a 7% utility users' tax to fund city services, with an exemption for low-income residents.

tax.text: A Yes vote would impose a 7% utility users tax to generate local funding for city services.
tax.quote: Measure Q: the City of Marina 911 Emergency, Public Safety, and Community Services Measure, asks voters to consider a 7% UUT, estimated to generate approximately $3.83 million annually for the City's General Fund

tax.text: A No vote would not impose the proposed 7% utility users tax.
tax.quote: Measure Q: the City of Marina 911 Emergency, Public Safety, and Community Services Measure, asks voters to consider a 7% UUT, estimated to generate approximately $3.83 million annually for the City's General Fund
